title: Patch: the AI prices a Dormant unit by the unit it wakes as
thread:
**Issue #2380 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2380: Patch: the AI prices a Dormant unit by the unit it wakes as
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Some new cards arrive asleep and wake a few turns later as a big unit. Imprisoned Cosmality, for example, costs 2 mana and wakes as a 10/6. To the practice AI a sleeping unit is worth nothing until it wakes. So the AI almost never plays these cards itself, and it doesn't prepare for the player's. Once this is built, the AI values a sleeping unit by what it will become, less the longer it has to wait. It plays these cards on curve and takes the player's seriously.

## Why

- `material()` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:453-458`) sums `unit_worth` over `active_units_of` only, and that leaves a Dormant card out (R1839000: "It is no Unit … the AI's evaluation and its lethal solver").
- That choice was made before any Dormant card shipped:
  - R1839000 says "No shipped card is Dormant yet".
  - The AI test file's header says the same (`crates/ai/tests/ai/slumber.rs:7-8`).
  - The test pins "Its own Dormant card counts for nothing either, until it wakes" (`slumber.rs:95-117`).
- The latest sweep of record (`training/history/sweep-2026-10-29-2.md`) shows how rarely the AI plays these cards:

| Card | Easy: affordable turns / plays | Hard: affordable turns / plays |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Imprisoned Cosmality (`stinkyscape-019`) | 64 / 3 | 110 / 1 |
| Imprisoned Ship Smith (`stinkyscape-017`) | 46 / 1 | 41 / 2 |
| Spacemine (a 2-cost unit), for comparison | 30 / 14 | 35 / 12 |

- A Dormant card's status and countdown are on both seats' views (`UnitView.slumber`, R185), so pricing it uses no hidden information.

## Proposal

- In `material()`, add a term for each Dormant card on the side (`units_on_field_of` keeps them): the `unit_worth` of the card awake, times a named discount for each turn left on its countdown.
- A card that waits for an effect to wake it, with no countdown, counts at a named share.
- The weights are named in `EvalWeights` and `AI_EVAL`. `GREEDY_EVAL` keeps 0, since it is frozen.
- Nothing else changes:
  - `legal_actions` still never offers an action through or onto a Dormant card;
  - the face-threat and lethal reads still ignore it until it wakes.
- A new ruling amends R1839000's sentence on the AI's evaluation.

## Where it lands

- AI: `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `crates/ai/tests/ai/slumber.rs` (the pinned test is rewritten under the new ruling), `crates/ai/README.md`.
- Spec: `spec/rulings/R1839000.md`, a new ruling note, `spec/pending/<issue>.md`. SPEC §6.1 (Dormant) and §9's practice AI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tests named after the new ruling:
  - the AI's own Dormant card scores above an empty zone, and an enemy one scores below it from the AI's side;
  - fewer turns left is worth more.
- [ ] With 2 mana and Imprisoned Cosmality its only play, `decide` plays it at Medium and Hard (today it ends the turn).
- [ ] Positions that differ only in a hidden card still give the same decision, and `GREEDY_EVAL` is unchanged.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` passes at smoke size, and the PR reports a `sweep` of `stinkyscape-017` and `stinkyscape-019` next to the numbers above.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## Size and risks

Hard (AI work by CLAUDE.md rule 11): about 7 files, 150 to 250 lines.

- The weights start untuned, as #1886's training-lane starts did. A small gate screen may not see a change confined to two cards.
- Any change to the evaluation can re-deal the seeded fixtures in the shadow-ban tests.
- The Dormant Starship hull in the backrow is still priced by its printed cost however many pieces have fused into it (`evaluate.rs:490-498`). That is left for a follow-up.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

Class: `ai` → `priority:low`; relabel to change it.

<!-- jackioh-bot -->

---
Comment by @jgoetzmann at 2026-10-29T15:41:06Z:

approve
```

# Draft plan, issue #2380 (planner notes; final plan = final message)

## Status
- Read: evaluate.rs (material, dormant_worth, unit_worth, face_threat), config.rs (EvalWeights/AI_EVAL/GREEDY_EVAL),
  engine slumber.rs, zones.rs (active_units_of/units_on_field_of), layers (no aura on slumbering), R1839000, §6.1 row, §9.9,
  tests/ai/slumber.rs, tests/ai/starship.rs, R2249000 (hull stands in backrow), R2259000 cards format, pending format.
- Experiment in /tmp/scratch-2380 (git archive HEAD; nothing in this tree):
  - Baseline: 2 mana, hand [Cosmality] only, empty boards, turn 3, AI p1, handicap None/medium/hard → EndTurn (seeds 0-3).
  - With the change at turn share 0.5 / waiting 0.5: Cosmality played at every tier and seed (Play c1 lane 1).
    Ship Smith still EndTurn even at 0.7 (learned correction outweighs; not in acceptance).
  - tests/ai binary: 640 pass, only the pinned r1839000 eval test fails (expected, rewritten).
  - ai_slow: running. Gate smoke: TODO.
- Weights named nowhere else (not exported to web/training). No patch fragment (AI kind, cf. #2376).

## Design (decided)
- Fold into material's unit loop: iterate `units_on_field_of`, `None` slumber → unit_worth, `Some` → `slumber_worth(state, unit, slumber.turns, w)`.
  Same order/sum as before when no Dormant card or at zero shares → GREEDY bit-identical.
- slumber_worth: share = turn_share.powi(turns) or waiting_share; 0 → 0.0 (no call); else clone, slumber=None, share*unit_worth.
- Weights `slumber_turn_share` 0.5, `slumber_waiting_share` 0.5 in AI_EVAL; 0.0 in GREEDY_EVAL.
- Dormant Starship hull standing in backrow keeps its backrow-loop price too (as every standing Unit); follow-up per issue.
- Ruling R2380000, pending spec/pending/2380.md; amend R1839000 "It is no Unit" + "Seen by both players"; §6.1 Dormant row; §9.9 Evaluation bullet.
- README: one sentence in "`decide` reads only `redact`".

## Tests (crates/ai/tests/ai/slumber.rs)
- rewrite pinned → r1839000_a_dormant_card_is_no_threat_until_it_wakes (face_threat asserts + asleep > awake for AI).
- r2380000_an_own_dormant_card_scores_above_an_empty_zone_and_an_enemy_one_below_it (exact diff = 0.25*unit_worth)
- r2380000_fewer_turns_left_is_worth_more
- r2380000_a_dormant_card_with_no_countdown_counts_at_the_waiting_share
- r2380000_greedy_eval_still_counts_a_dormant_card_as_nothing
- r2380000_decide_plays_imprisoned_cosmality_on_curve_at_medium_and_hard
- r2380000_positions_that_differ_only_in_a_hidden_card_give_the_same_decision
